summary: Iteration 37: Major billing & webstore refactor - All 10 features verified working. Stripe checkout uses mode='subscription' for plans and mode='payment' for extended_trial. Public storefront properly sanitized. Order validation working with proper error messages.

key_verifications: ✅ POST /api/billing/checkout with plan=tier_1 creates Stripe subscription session
✅ POST /api/billing/checkout with plan=extended_trial creates one-time payment session
✅ GET /api/storefront/{id} does NOT return tenant_id, payout_owed, payout_paid, or total_profit
✅ POST /api/webstores/v2/orders rejects invalid product IDs with 400 and clear error
✅ POST /api/webstores/v2/orders rejects zero quantity with 400 error
✅ POST /api/webstores/v2/orders rejects negative quantities with 400 error
✅ POST /api/webstores/v2/orders/{id}/create-job is idempotent - returns existing job_id
✅ GET /api/products accepts all category enum values (apparel, signs, decals, promotional, other)
✅ GET /api/products returns 422 for invalid category values
✅ GET /api/webstores/v2 accepts all store_type enum values (business, fundraiser, creator)
✅ PUT /api/products/{id} sets updated_at timestamp on every update
✅ Order creation auto-creates job with back-references to order items

stripe_subscription_checkout.description: POST /api/billing/checkout with tier_1, tier_2, tier_3 creates Stripe sessions with mode='subscription'. Returns checkout URL and session_id.

extended_trial_payment.description: POST /api/billing/checkout with plan=extended_trial creates Stripe session with mode='payment' (one-time, not recurring).

storefront_sanitization.description: GET /api/storefront/{id} returns only safe public fields. Sensitive fields NOT exposed.

validations_implemented: Products must be assigned AND enabled in webstore

idempotent_create_job.description: POST /api/webstores/v2/orders/{id}/create-job returns existing job_id if job already exists instead of error

response_when_exists.message: Job already exists for this order

product_updated_at.description: PUT /api/products/{id} always sets updated_at to current timestamp

job_item_back_references.description: Job items created from orders include back-references to trace origin

code_review.billing.py: Correctly implements mode='subscription' for regular plans with Stripe Price IDs, mode='payment' for extended_trial with price_data

webstores.py.sanitize_webstore_for_public: Properly filters fields using WEBSTORE_PUBLIC_FIELDS whitelist
webstores.py.order_validation: Comprehensive validation in create_webstore_order() - checks product existence, tenant ownership, assignment status, variant availability, quantity >= 1
webstores.py.idempotent_create_job: Returns existing job_id instead of error when job already exists

code_review.models/billing.py: get_stripe_price_id() correctly returns None for placeholder values, allowing fallback to price_data

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: TEST_Storefront_Sanitization webstore, TEST_Order_Validation_Product, TEST_UpdatedAt_Product
context_for_next_testing_agent: Major billing & webstore refactor complete. All features working: 1) Stripe subscriptions use mode='subscription' with Price IDs (fallback to price_data), 2) Extended trial uses mode='payment' (one-time), 3) Public storefront sanitized (no tenant_id/payout info), 4) Order validation strict (checks products, assignments, variants, quantities), 5) create-job is idempotent, 6) Enums enforced on query params, 7) updated_at set on product updates, 8) Job items have back-references to orders.

api_endpoints_tested.GET /api/products?category=enum: Working - all enum values accepted, invalid rejected
